GameplayDescription: ['The Mother moves with brute force. All attacks initiated by its <color=#ffda58>hind legs</color> can be parried.', 'After the Mother goes airborne and launches continuous attacks, successfully parrying <color=#ffda58>all attacks</color> in the combo will trigger a <color=#ffda58>knockdown</color> effect.', 'After the Mother goes airborne and launches continuous attacks, <color=#ffda58>failing to parry all attacks</color> will cause the Mother to immediately deal AOE DMG and enhance its skills temporarily.']

['Primal Projection can actively parry your attacks. After a certain number of parries, she will unleash a devastating strike. This strike varies between <color=#ffda58>parryable and unparryable</color> types. Stay alert, Commandant!', "When Primal Projection's bombs hit you, she triggers <color=#ffda58>Dimensional Snare</color>, pulling you into the center of the explosion.", 'Primal Projection casts a field with ground-binding properties that ignores Dodge and Invincibility. Quickly move out of the area to evade it, or you will be restrained by <color=#ffda58>Dimensional Snare</color>.']

["Once Moon Eater's Super Armor is <color=#34aff9>depleted</color>, <color=#34aff9>dodging its blue-glowing attacks</color> causes its limbs to overcharge and glow red. Attack the red limbs to sever them and deal massive damage.", 'The Moon Eater detaches its head to charge up an explosion. When its <color=#34aff9>head glows yellow</color>, dodge immediately to avoid the subsequent full-screen explosion damage.']

['Upon a distinct <color=#ffda58>yellow double diamond</color> indicator, Zack will cast ice waves or perform melee attacks. Rosetta: Arete can trigger <color=#ffda58>Precise Jump</color> to dodge it. When she does that, <color=#ffda58>keep tapping Basic Attack</color> to counter and interrupt his current skill.', 'When facing Zack, Rosetta: Arete can trigger <color=#ffda58>Precise Jump</color> by <color=#ffda58>tapping Yellow Orbs</color> to use Phantom Descent in Forest Guard Mimic (human form), or by <color=#ffda58>tapping Morph Orbs</color> to use Shadow Reversion or performing a <color=#ffda58>directional Dodge</color> in Nessos Mimic (centaur form).', 'This skill is only used while Zack is in his "Ultimate Amalgamation" state. He commands the ice sea to flood the entire battlefield. As the ice sea surges forward, cast Signature Move to evade the damage. At the perfect moment, Rosetta: Arete can <color=#ffda58>use Morph Orbs</color> to switch Mimics, seeing through Zack\'s skill and <color=#ffda58>executing</color> him.']
